description.value: A McDonald's Canada franchise location in Chilliwack on Clearbrook Road, offering burgers, chicken, McCafé beverages, and breakfast. The site includes a drive-through lane for cyclists wanting quick service without dismounting. As a national chain with an in-app rewards program, it offers a reliable calorie stop on routes through the Fraser Valley.
